_comment: One record per model page (T-10, docs/audit/PARTS_LOOK_PLAN.md). Only what the page states; null when it doesn't say. Photos described in words, never copied. Codex imports confidence 'page' records into catalog.json (T-11).
method: page read in a browser (MakerWorld), print profile list expanded; our drawing compared with tools/looks.html and the 3D view

pages.pageNotes: A review (2026-03-23) reports missing holes in the bolted non-XL version.
